title: Closed source construction of a w-contractible ind-etale extension
statement: For every commutative ring R in Type u, there are a commutative ring D in Type u and an R-algebra structure such that D is ind-etale over R [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-algebra], faithfully flat as an R-module [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map], and w-contractible in the geometric sense: Spec D is w-local, the localizations at all maximal ideals are strictly henselian, and the connected-component space of Spec D is extremally disconnected. These last conditions are precisely the source-library class IsWContractibleRing D. Universes follow [def-weil-size-convention]; no nontriviality hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: This is the already-proved exists_isWContractibleRing theorem. Its construction first takes WStrictLocalization R. For a w-strictly-local ring, take a projective compact Hausdorff presentation of the profinite connected-component space; its source T is extremally disconnected and the presentation is surjective. Pull back the spectrum along T by WContractification.PullbackProfinite. The result D is ind-Zariski and faithfully flat over the strict localization. Its spectrum is w-local, its maximal local rings identify with strictly henselian maximal local rings of the strict localization, and its component space identifies with T. Thus D is w-contractible. Compose algebra structures with R to the strict localization; ind-etaleness and faithful flatness compose. All objects are constructed in Type u. This theorem is closed in the source library, so no further proof obligations are introduced.
